entries.e36e1acbdc7ccb04: Starting in 1896 as a pioneer in thermal insulation in Japan, it provides products and services using six core technologies: sealing, insulation, soundproofing, fire resistance, corrosion resistance and clean technology, built around “Cut and Preserve.” Research and development is conducted through a structure comprising two research institutes, the Hamamatsu Research Institute and the Tsurumi Research Institute, and the technology development departments of each business division.
entries.fcd233868af7104b: Under its corporate philosophy, “We will contribute to a bright future for the Earth through our ‘Cut and Preserve’ technologies,” and its long-term vision “‘Cut and Preserve’ Toward a Bright Future,” it is advancing the medium-term management plan “Shikumi 130” (fiscal years ended March 2023 to March 2027), with the fiscal year ended March 2027 as its final year. The plan presents an image of revenue of ¥275 billion for the fiscal year ended March 2027.
